description: Clariia AI Inbox creates private pending review cards for the connected Clariia user. It supports tasks, notes, ideas, project drafts, blog drafts, social posts, newsletter drafts, recipes, and supported images. Nothing is published or sent to a final destination until the user reviews and approves it inside Clariia.

defaultPrompt: Send the newsletter above to my Clariia AI Inbox for review.
